notes:
Summary: Stalled account — POC never kicked off. High technical interest (embeddings + reranking) but two main failure modes: 1) misaligned success criteria across stakeholders, 2) resourcing + budget freeze.

Key points / verbatim: 
- "We need audit logs and the model to run inside our VPC" — security (S. Alvarez) on 2026-01-14.
- Product lead (M. Dao): "If autocomplete isn't <50ms it's a non-starter" — caused scope tension with cost targets.
- Procurement: asked for TCO and committed headcount for a 6-week POC; Ashbourne hit hiring freeze late Jan so cannot staff.

Why POC didn't start: 
- No aligned success criteria: product team focusing on latency SLAs, ops/legal on residency + audit/KMS. SE and AE couldn't get a single short POC that satisfied both without significant infra spend.
- Budget freeze/hiring freeze prevented customer from committing engineering time for integration (connector + on-prem infra).
- Security asked for ISO documentation and a penetration test schedule; timeline slipped and customer paused external vendor evaluations.
- Customer ran a parallel lightweight POC with Anthropic managed endpoints (internal note: competitor POC focusing on ease-of-onboarding, not residency).

Sales attempts so far: 
- Multiple follow-ups Nov-Jan (emails + 2 SE workshops). Tried to propose trimmed POC (embeddings only, hosted with strict egress policy) but legal rejected hosted option.
- AE pushed for executive sponsor intro; product champion left for another company in late Jan — main internal champion gone.

Next recommended playbook: 
- Low-effort re-engage in Q3 post-hiring freeze: short note to exec sponsor target and SE to propose 2 concrete POC options (1) on-prem short pilot (3 weeks, paid), (2) hosted-with-custodian approach limited to sanitized data.
- Prepare ISO27001 packages, pen-test summary, and KMS integration notes (pull from RDC security FAQ).
- If customer remains unresponsive by 2026-06, mark as closed-lost and capture competitor learnings (ease-of-onboarding prioritized over residency in their evaluation).

Artifacts: pricing deck, security FAQ attached in Drive. Gmail thread with procurement contains negotiation draft. Fireflies call ids above for transcripts.

Sales sentiment: cold — account unlikely to progress before Q3 due to budget and lack of champion. Recommend deprioritize but keep 6-month nurture cadence.
